hualien.name: Taiwan KOM Challenge
hualien.note: Sea level at Qixingtan to 3,275m at Wuling through Taroko Gorge — ~7% for 90km, then ramps to 27%. One of the world's hardest climbs.

mallorca.name: Mallorca 312 — 167 route
mallorca.note: The island classic across the Serra de Tramuntana from Playa de Muro. 312 / 225 / 167km options; next edition late April 2027.

bentonville.name: Big Sugar Gravel — 100mi
bentonville.note: Life Time Grand Prix finale on the chunky Ozark gravel around Bentonville — 104mi / ~7,000ft. Full pro field.

medellin.name: El Giro de Rigo — Medellín route
medellin.note: Rigoberto Urán's gran fondo as it ran from Medellín over Alto de Las Palmas to Rionegro (Reto Caimán, 160km). The 2026 edition moves to Barranquilla.

medellin.name: Tour Colombia — Alto de Las Palmas
medellin.note: The WorldTour peloton raced the Antioquia climbs of Las Palmas and Santa Elena around Medellín and Rionegro in 2019–2020.

adelaide-hills.name: Tour Down Under — Willunga stage
adelaide-hills.note: Ride the iconic Willunga Hill decider and the Adelaide Hills circuits from the WorldTour season-opener. Next edition January 2027.

bright.name: Audax Alpine Classic — 250km
bright.note: Australia Day weekend institution from Bright over Mt Buffalo, Tawonga Gap and Falls Creek. 320 / 250 / 200 / 140km options.

bright.name: Peaks Challenge Falls Creek
bright.note: 235km / 4,500m around the high country — Tawonga Gap, Mt Hotham and the ‘Beast’ at the back of Falls Creek. 13-hour limit.

girona.name: Sea Otter Europe — Gran Fondo
girona.note: Europe's biggest cycling festival — road & gravel gran fondos and the UCI Gravel World Series, all from Girona.

girona.name: Volta a Catalunya — Girona roads
girona.note: WorldTour racing regularly rolls through the Girona hills the pros call home. Next Volta late March 2027.

derby.name: UCI Enduro World Cup — Derby
derby.note: Blue Derby hosts a round of the UCI Enduro World Cup — the world's best gravity racers on the famous Tasmanian loam.

onomichi.name: Cycling Shimanami — Long Course
onomichi.note: Held once every two years, the Nishiseto Expressway closes to cars and opens to 7,000 riders — Onomichi to Imabari and back.

dalat.name: HTV Cup — Stage to Da Lat
dalat.note: Vietnam's biggest stage race climbs to Da Lat over the Khanh Le and Giang Ly passes, run each April around Reunification Day.

ubud.name: GFNY Bali — Gran Fondo Kintamani
ubud.note: A 20km ascent to the Kintamani crater rim above Lake Batur — 134km gran fondo / 94km medio. Dates via GFNY Bali.

jeju.name: Jeju Round-the-Island
jeju.note: Circumnavigate the island on the 234km Fantasy Bikeway with the Jeju Tourism Organisation festival. Dates via the organiser.

sunmoonlake.name: Come! BikeDay — Round-the-Lake
sunmoonlake.note: The Taiwan Cycling Festival's flagship ride around Sun Moon Lake — culture, music and the classic 30km lake loop.

pokhara.name: Pokhara Enduro
pokhara.note: Three days of technical Himalayan descents and flowy corners above Pokhara — 4th edition, 10–12 December 2026.

noosa.name: Noosa Classic
noosa.note: Sunshine Coast gran fondo into the Noosa hinterland — 160 / 120 / 65km. Register interest for the next date.

chiangmai.name: Doi Inthanon Hill Climb
chiangmai.note: A timed assault on the roof of Thailand. Illustrative — Chiang Mai's race calendar is still being verified.

hagiang.name: Ha Giang Loop Challenge
hagiang.note: The legendary Ma Pi Leng circuit as a timed challenge. Illustrative event for the demo.

beechworth.name: Murray to Mountains Gran Fondo
beechworth.note: A rail-trail-and-hills century through historic gold country. Illustrative event for the demo.
